Order 
There is an office objection as regards maintainability of this application.
2 . As the applicant himself belongs to scheduled category, therefore, this application under Section 483 of BNSS is maintainable.
Office objection is ignored.
3. The counsel for the State submits that notice upon victim has been served.

4. This is first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (Section 439 of Cr.P.C.) for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.
50/2021 dated 03.04.2021 registered at Police Station, Paraswada, District Balaghat for the offences punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(1), 376-D of IPC and under Section 3(1)(w-i) and 3(2)(v) of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989.

sentences.text: Psychologist of the D.D.R.C., Balaghat made efforts to record the statement of the of the victim, but the victim did not give any information and thereafter through an Audiologist statement of the victim was recorded.
It is contended by the counsel that during investigation statement of the maternal uncle of the victim was also recorded.
Later on, allegations were levelled against three persons, namely, Roshanlal, Binde and Bipat (the present applicant).
The DNA in respect of the present applicant is negative and the same has been found positive in respect of other co-accused namely Binde.
It is further submitted that co-accused Roshanlal has already been released on bail by this Court vide order dated 47461 of 2024 and the case of the present applicant is on similar footing.
It is thus, contended by the counsel that the present applicant was not involved in commission of the offence and he deserves to be enlarged on bail.

6. The counsel for the State has opposed the application and submitted that when the voters list was shown to the victim she indicated towards the present applicant and other co-accused persons, and on the basis of which implication has been made.
However, counsel for the State does not dispute that the DNA report in respect of the present applicant is negative, on the contrary the same is positive in respect of co-accused Binde.
7. Heard the submissions and perused the case diary.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:723 3 MCRC-54866-2024 8 .

Considering the totality of the circumstances of the case, the fact that allegations were levelled against three persons,
namely, Roshanlal, Binde and Bipat (the present applicant) and co-accused Roshanlal has already been released on bail and case of the present applicant is similar to him.
The DNA in respect of the present applicant is negative and the same has been found positive in respect of co-accused Binde
thus, this Court deems it proper to release the present applicant on bail.
Therefore, without commenting on the merit of the case, the application is allowed.

9. It is directed that applicant - Bipat Meravi shall be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed by that Court in this regard during the pendency of trial.
10. It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 480(3) of the Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
